info.title: evony-re API
info.description: Evony Age 1 game server. Successful calls answer `{ ok: 1, data }`; failures `{ ok: <negative code>, errorMsg }` with a 4xx status. Live updates (`server.*` pushes of the original protocol) arrive on the WebSocket at `/ws?token=...` as `{ cmd, data }`.
